fields.label: Icon Key
fields.tooltip: [icon-key] The key used by the component in the Icon Lore. If this is set to "example" and has a value name of "value", it can be referenced using the string "{attr:example.value}".

fields.tooltipZh: 配置“目标阵营”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Spread
fields.tooltip: [spread] The orientation for firing projectiles. Cone will fire arrows in a cone centered on your reticle. Horizontal cone does the same as cone, just locked to the XZ axis (parallel to the ground). Rain drops the projectiles from above the target. For firing one arrow straight, use "Cone"
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“散布”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Amount
fields.tooltip: [amount] The number of projectiles to fire
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“数量”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.tooltipZh: 配置“速度”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Angle

fields.tooltipZh: 配置“角度”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Icon Key
fields.tooltip: [icon-key] The key used by the component in the Icon Lore. If this is set to "example" and has a value name of "value", it can be referenced using the string "{attr:example.value}".
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“图标引用键”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Counts as Cast
fields.tooltip: [counts] Whether or not this mechanic running treats the skill as "casted" and will consume mana and start the cooldown. Set to false if it is a mechanic appled when the skill fails such as cleanup or an error message.

fields.tooltip: [steps] The number of times to play particles and apply translations each application.
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“步数”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Frequency
fields.tooltip: [frequency] How often to apply the animation in seconds. 0.05 is the fastest (1 tick). Lower than that will act the same.
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“频率”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Angle
fields.tooltip: [angle] How far the animation should rotate over the duration in degrees
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“角度”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Start Angle
fields.tooltip: [start] The starting orientation of the animation. Horizontal translations and the forward/right offsets will be based off of this.
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“起始角度”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Duration

fields.tooltipZh: 配置“持续时间”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: H-Translation
fields.tooltip: [h-translation] How far the animation moves horizontally relative to the center over a cycle. Positive values make it expand from the center while negative values make it contract.
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“水平平移”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: V-Translation
fields.tooltip: [v-translation] How far the animation moves vertically over a cycle. Positive values make it rise while negative values make it sink.
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“垂直平移”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

description: Pushes the target relative to the caster. This will do nothing if used with the caster as the target. Positive numbers apply knockback while negative numbers pull them in.

fields.label: Icon Key
fields.tooltip: [icon-key] The key used by the component in the Icon Lore. If this is set to "example" and has a value name of "value", it can be referenced using the string "{attr:example.value}".
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“图标引用键”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Counts as Cast
fields.tooltip: [counts] Whether or not this mechanic running treats the skill as "casted" and will consume mana and start the cooldown. Set to false if it is a mechanic appled when the skill fails such as cleanup or an error message.
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“计为技能施放”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Type
fields.tooltip: [type] How to scale the speed based on relative position. Fixed does the same speed to all targets. Inverse pushes enemies farther away faster. Scaled pushes enemies closer faster.
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“类型”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Speed
fields.tooltip: [speed] How fast to push the target away. Use a negative value to pull them closer.
fields.tooltipZh: 配置“速度”，该值会按技能等级传入节点执行逻辑。

fields.label: Source
fields.tooltip: [source] The source to push/pull from. This should be a key used in a Remember Targets mechanic. If no targets are remembered, this will default to the caster.
